_readme: Question SHAPE for the 48 django SWE-QA questions. Written 2026-08-03 from the question text alone, BEFORE any arm's per-question performance was looked at, because a classification made after seeing which questions an arm won is selection on the outcome and is unfalsifiable afterwards. See harness/question_shapes.py for the taxonomy, the two findings that fall out of the distribution, and the committed stratified draw.
_source: data/swe_qa/tasks.json, the 48 rows with repo django/django
_classified_by: session 9, from question text only, no arm results consulted
_taxonomy: PLAN.md Phase 3, plus performance-why which PLAN.md's list does not contain
